description: This Java class 'LayoutUsageData' handles refactoring operations related to Android layout XML files, specifically inlining layout tags and managing namespace declarations within XML tags.

classes.name: LayoutUsageData
classes.description: A class for managing and performing refactoring operations on Android layout XML tags, including inlining tags and managing namespace declarations.

methods.name: getReference
methods.description: Returns the Android resource reference associated with this layout usage data.

methods.name: inline
methods.description: Performs inlining of the layout tag, either as a single tag or as multiple tags if the root is a 'merge' tag.

methods.name: inlineSingleTag
methods.description: Inlines a single layout include tag into its parent, copying attributes and removing namespace declarations as needed.

methods.name: inlineMultiTags
methods.description: Inlines a 'merge' layout tag by merging its subtags into the parent, managing namespace declarations accordingly.

methods.name: addNamespaceAttributes
methods.description: Adds namespace declaration attributes to an XML tag.

methods.name: replaceByTagContent
methods.description: Replaces an XML tag's content with the inner content of another tag, updating the document accordingly.
